convention: Equal-weight mean of per-airport paired deltas; fixed-PST calendar days resampled jointly across airports. CI = estimate ± quantile(|draw − estimate|) at 0.95 (Bonferroni: 1 − 0.05/6). Two-sided p = (1 + count(|draw − estimate| ≥ |estimate|))/(valid draws + 1). AP gains are positive; RPS gains are negative. A pooled draw is valid only if every included airport has rows (and, for AP, positive labels); invalid draws are discarded jointly, never by dropping an airport from the mean.
holm_family: all family pairs within each task, separately for AP and secondary RPS
